Broken streetlights on Elm Ave
issues.description: Several streetlights on Elm Avenue have been non-functional for 3 weeks posing safety risks at night.

issues.title: Overcrowded public school classrooms
issues.description: Classes at Lincoln Elementary are averaging 38 students per teacher, well above the recommended limit.

responses.text: Thank you for raising this. We are working with the school board to address overcrowding by next semester.

issues.title: Pothole damage on Main Street
issues.description: Large potholes near the intersection of Main and 5th have damaged multiple vehicles.

responses.text: Repairs have been scheduled and completed. Thank you for reporting.

issues.title: Lack of recycling bins in the park
issues.description: Riverside Park has no recycling facilities leading to increased littering.

issues.title: Public transit delays on Route 12
issues.description: Route 12 buses have been consistently 20-30 minutes late impacting commuters.

updates.title: Budget Allocation for Infrastructure
updates.content: We are pleased to announce that $2.4M has been allocated for road repairs and streetlight upgrades across District 4. Work begins next month.

updates.title: Town Hall Meeting - March 5th
updates.content: Join us for an open town hall at Community Center, 6 PM on March 5th. Bring your questions and concerns. All residents welcome.

updates.title: New Park Facilities Approved
updates.content: The city council has approved the installation of new playground equipment, benches, and recycling facilities at Riverside Park.

discussions.title: Should we increase public transit frequency?
discussions.body: Given the growing population, it makes sense to discuss increasing bus frequency on major routes. What does the community think?

replies.text: Absolutely! Route 12 delays are a daily frustration for thousands of commuters.

discussions.title: Green spaces in the city - your thoughts?
discussions.body: The city is considering converting unused lots into green spaces. Looking for community feedback before finalizing plans.
